clips.title: The story
paras: Swine feed Orgrimmar from Rocktusk Farm, just beyond the city gates in northern Durotar. The farm supplies meat and provisions to the capital, where dry, stony ground makes crops hard to grow.

Rocktusk Farm raises hardy swine on Durotar’s dry, stony ground. Crops are difficult to grow here, so the farm helps feed Orgrimmar’s growing population. Close to the capital’s fortified perimeter, it is safer than homesteads in the wild red canyonlands.
